display.purpose: The two-line personal name and no other content.

headline.purpose: Major section titles and the contact heading.

lead.purpose: The concise role statement beside the personal name.

title.purpose: Project names and technologies in the signature stack band.

body-large.purpose: High-value factual content in skill and background rows.

body.purpose: Descriptions, availability, contact details, and supporting copy.

label.purpose: Navigation, categories, statuses, language controls, and metadata.

motion.name: stack-scan-once

motion.name: direct-state

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The main email action: square, cobalt, and visually decisive.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-action-primary { border-color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue); color: var(--white); } .ds-action-primary:hover, .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--blue-dark); background: var(--blue-dark); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A transparent graphite action that reverses on interaction.
components.html: GitHub
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-action svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-left: 0.65rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-action-secondary:hover, .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); } .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Centered condensed links with a cobalt current-section rule.
components.html: SkillsProjectsBackgroundContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.75rem); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -16px; left: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--blue); content: ""; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="location"] { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="location"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 860px) { .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-nav-link { justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 0.82rem; } .ds-nav-link:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-nav-link::after { bottom: 0; } }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: A fused EN/FI/SV control with a graphite active cell.
components.css: .ds-language-switch { display: flex; width: max-content; border: 1px solid var(--line-dark); } .ds-language-switch button { width: 42px; height: 38px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--line-dark); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-language-switch button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-language-switch button:hover, .ds-language-switch button:focus-visible { background: var(--blue-soft); color: var(--ink); } .ds-language-switch button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); } .ds-language-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 860px) { .ds-language-switch button { width: 44px; height: 44px; } }

components.name: Current Stack Band
components.description: The signature four-cell cobalt row with one non-looping scan pass.
components.css: .ds-stack-band { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; background: var(--blue); color: var(--white); } .ds-stack-band::after { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: -15%; width: 8%; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 24%); content: ""; animation: ds-scan-once 900ms 180ms var(--ease-out) both; pointer-events: none; } .ds-stack-band span { padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem); border-right: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 45%); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.45rem); font-weight: 600; } .ds-stack-band span:last-child { border-right: 0; } @keyframes ds-scan-once { to { transform: translateX(1500%); } } @media (max-width: 860px) { .ds-stack-band { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-stack-band span:nth-child(2) { border-right: 0; } .ds-stack-band span:nth-child(-n + 2) { border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 45%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stack-band::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms; animation-iteration-count: 1; } }

components.name: Skill Ledger Row
components.description: A full-width ruled label-and-content row for factual skills.
components.html:
Application development
TypeScript, React, Node.js, Hono, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Zod
components.css: .ds-skill-ledger { margin: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-dark); } .ds-skill-ledger > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; padding-block: 1.75rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-dark); } .ds-skill-ledger dt { grid-column: 1 / span 4; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-skill-ledger dd { grid-column: 5 / -1; margin: 0; max-width: 72ch; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 2vw, 1.5rem); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.45; } @media (max-width: 860px) { .ds-skill-ledger > div { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-skill-ledger dt, .ds-skill-ledger dd { grid-column: 1; } }

components.name: Interactive Project Row
components.description: A ruled project record that reverses to cobalt on hover or keyboard focus.
components.html: VesipolkuPlanning tool for water utilities.Live
components.css: .ds-project-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(10rem, 2fr) minmax(15rem, 5fr) auto 20px; gap: 1.25rem; align-items: center; min-height: 82px; padding: 1rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-dark); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-dark); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, padding 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-project-row:hover, .ds-project-row:focus-visible { padding-inline: 1rem; background: var(--blue); color: var(--white); outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-project-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-project-description { color: var(--muted); } .ds-project-row:hover .ds-project-description, .ds-project-row:focus-visible .ds-project-description { color: var(--white); } .ds-project-status { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-project-row svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-width: 1.5; } @media (max-width: 860px) { .ds-project-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto 18px; gap: 0.65rem 1rem; min-height: 96px; } .ds-project-name { grid-column: 1; } .ds-project-description { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; } .ds-project-status { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; } .ds-project-row svg { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; } }

components.name: Contact Plane
components.description: A square cobalt contact field with white links and no elevation.
components.css: .ds-contact-plane { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; padding: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 7rem) clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 5rem); border-radius: 0; background: var(--blue); color: var(--white); } .ds-contact-plane h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5vw, 4.4rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 0.95; } .ds-contact-plane p { margin: 2rem 0 1rem; color: #dfe4ff; } .ds-contact-plane a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 0.1rem; color: var(--white); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.3rem); font-weight: 500; } .ds-contact-plane a:hover, .ds-contact-plane a:focus-visible { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-contact-plane a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--white); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
JRWL is a maintained technical reference sheet: precise, current, and optimized for a recruiter’s short scan. Near-white paper, graphite type, and hard rules establish the working surface; cobalt identifies the current stack, decisive actions, and the contact plane.

The interface stays flat and type-led. Archivo Narrow compresses identity and section structure while Archivo keeps sentences readable; square controls and full-width rows make every transition explicit. Motion is limited to one left-to-right scan across the stack band, then the page becomes still.

The system must remain factual and multilingual across English, Finnish, and Swedish. It explicitly rejects maritime themes, symbols, logos, charts, technology-badge clouds, portfolio dashboards, and ship-derived visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white paper, graphite text, and cobalt emphasis.
Archivo Narrow structure paired with Archivo body copy.
Square controls, hard rules, and full-width information rows.
Flat depth with one non-looping stack-row scan.
Responsive layouts that preserve 44-pixel mobile targets and EN/FI/SV wrapping.

rules.name: The Cobalt Allocation Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks the current stack, decisive actions, contact information, or active interaction; it is not decoration.

rules.name: The Graphite Skeleton Rule
rules.body: Hard graphite and slate rules create structure; do not replace them with cards, shadows, or soft tinted containers.

rules.name: The Condensed Structure Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo Narrow for identity, section structure, navigation, labels, and status; use Archivo for sentences, descriptions, and data.

rules.name: The Full-Width Evidence Rule
rules.body: Information rows span their container and separate with rules; avoid floating cards, badges, and tile grids.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat at rest; hierarchy comes from type, rules, and cobalt planes, never shadows.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce pills, rounded cards, soft chips, or curved control shells; the implemented radius is zero.

dos: Do reserve cobalt for the current stack, primary action, contact plane, active navigation, selection, focus, and strong row interaction.
Do build hierarchy with Archivo Narrow, Archivo, hard rules, spacing, and full-width rows.
Do keep controls square and keyboard focus visible with a 3-pixel outline and 3-pixel offset.
Do preserve flexible copy widths and 44-pixel targets across English, Finnish, and Swedish.
Do let the stack scan run once, then leave the page still; honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't introduce maritime themes, symbols, logos, charts, or ship-derived visual language.
Don't turn the profile into a portfolio dashboard, technology-badge cloud, chart, or proof-theatre interface.
Don't soften the system with pills, rounded cards, gradients, shadows, or floating panels.
Don't spread cobalt across arbitrary decorative surfaces; its scarcity carries meaning.
Don't add looping, ambient, parallax, or scroll-bound motion.
